changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 3 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/6519-retired-field-key-strip.md`

- names `plugin-designer/src/MetadataFieldsPage.tsx` → `packages/plugin-designer/src/MetadataFieldsPage.tsx` — edited by this change

  > Unifying the three retired-key lists on this seam is deliberately not part of this change: it spans `plugin-designer/src/MetadataFieldsPage.tsx`, which objectui#6489 owns in flight.

### `.changeset/6681-declared-lazy-marketplace-routes.md`

- names `views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` — edited by this change

  > Both marketplace chunks were held by CHUNK CO-TENANCY, not by any import of the page: rolldown had parked `components/SuggestedBindingsPanel.tsx` (statically imported by the eager `views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`) in the first, and `console/marketplace/InstalledListWidget.tsx` (bare-imported by the package barrel for its SDUI registration) in the second. An `app-shell-eager-leaves` group in `apps/console/vite.config.ts` isolates those co-tenants so the three declared-lazy pages chunk by their own dynamic-only reachability. The console eager closure moves 3180.2 KB → 3171.5 KB gzipped (−8,888 bytes, 48 → 45 eager chunks) with the three per-chunk ceilings unmoved.

### `.changeset/8568-retire-dollar-dialect-lowercase-aliases.md`

- names `packages/data-objectstack/README.md` → `packages/data-objectstack/README.md` — edited by this change

  > `packages/data-objectstack/README.md`'s operator tables follow the implementation, as does the reconciliation test that holds them to it.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `20d23befe` (merge-base with origin/main): 11 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1931 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2550 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36854634623)

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `a1eb87fa39aeb32c32e2fe447a17c9353319bcd9`
Local-runs: none

Inputs: card objectui#11302 (body, triage `5923866197`, claim `5929723727`, dev report `5930283862`), PR objectui#11378 (body, 14-file list, net diff `c82ff391f7..a1eb87fa39`), objectui `AGENTS.md` at the head, and the head's check-runs. Read-only: nothing built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Public surface, `@object-ui/data-objectstack` — right.** The barrel gains `formatMetadataError` and `formatMetadataIssue` from a new `src/metadata-error.ts`. `extractIssues` is exported at module level only and the package's `exports` map exposes `.` alone, so it is not a published path. Additive; nothing existing moved.
- **Public surface, `@object-ui/app-shell` — right, no break.** `views/studio-design/metadataError.ts` loses `formatMetadataError` / `extractIssues`. At the base, `packages/app-shell/src/index.ts` re-exports from `studio-design` only `BuilderLanding`, the `StudioDesignSurface` members and the `studio-canvas-preview` members, and `package.json` `exports` maps only `.` and `./styles.css`, so neither symbol was ever published. The one importer of the module outside its directory, `console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx`, takes `formatPublishFailures`, which stays. The dev's "nothing outside app-shell imported the module" holds (a `git grep` at the base finds the symbols only in `studio-design/`, changeset prose and CHANGELOGs).
- **The move is behaviour-preserving — right.** `extractIssues` is byte-identical; `issueLine` became `formatMetadataIssue` with the same template (`• PATH — MESSAGE`, `(root)` for an empty path); `formatMetadataError` differs only in the renamed call. The four `formatMetadataError` cases and the `extractIssues` case moved unchanged into `metadata-error.test.ts`, plus one new `formatMetadataIssue` case; app-shell's test keeps the publish formatter's cases.
- **One reader — right.** The three app-shell callers (`ObjectHooksPanel`, `PackageOwdOverviewPanel`, `StudioDesignSurface`) import `formatMetadataError` from `@object-ui/data-objectstack`; `formatPublishFailures` now writes its lines through `formatMetadataIssue`, same grammar, its two consumers (`StudioDesignSurface`, `AiChatPage`) untouched. `MetadataFieldsPage` sets `error: formatMetadataError(err)` on both catch paths (`reload` and `handleFieldsChange`). The only other issue-shaped code in the diff is the pin's gate double (`toMetadataIssues`, `headline`), which models the SERVER envelope, and the pin asserts the banner byte-for-byte against `formatMetadataIssue`. No second formatter anywhere in the diff.
- **Accept set of the page's banner — right, and the load path is harmless.** Against the old `err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)`, the reader is identical for an `Error` and for a primitive, lists the issues when `err.issues` is an array, and differs otherwise only for a non-Error object carrying `message` (now that message, formerly `[object Object]`), a widening in the author's favour. `toFieldsMap`'s pre-request `throw new Error(...)` carries no issues, so its text is unchanged. The banner stays a `pre` with `whitespace-pre-wrap`, so the newline-joined list renders one issue per line.
- **The home — right.** Manifests at the head: app-shell carries `@object-ui/plugin-designer` in `peerDependencies` and `devDependencies` (so plugin-designer cannot import app-shell); plugin-designer's `dependencies` already carry `@object-ui/data-objectstack` (no manifest in the diff is correct); app-shell's `dependencies` carry it too; data-objectstack depends only on `@object-ui/core` and `@object-ui/types`, so no cycle. `Pre-Install Import Graph Check` concluded success.
- **`ResourceEditPage` left unconverged — consistent with the rule for this card, not blocking.** Triage's text named it a user of the shared reader; at the base it never imported `formatMetadataError` (no hit in the file). Its 422 branch reads `err?.body?.issues` into inline `SchemaFormIssue`s through `translateValidationMessage`: a different rendering, pre-existing, outside the card's file surface. "⛔ No second issue formatter" governs what the fields page renders and what this diff adds; it does not order a convergence of that surface, and the dev measured the discrepancy instead of inheriting the premise. Judged right.

### ② Semver level

- `@object-ui/data-objectstack` **minor** — right: two new barrel exports widen the public surface, and the ruled level rule reads "a bug fix in a released package takes `patch` UNLESS the PR declares `Clause-②: yes`, in which case at least `minor`". `@object-ui/plugin-designer` **patch** — right: a rendering fix, no new export. `@object-ui/app-shell` **patch** — right: an internal re-point, nothing published changed. Fixed group (`.changeset/config.json` `fixed`, 39 packages): the group bumps `minor` together; no `major` declared, as AGENTS.md's no-major rule requires. `Changeset Declaration`, `Changeset Bump Policy`, `Changeset Fixed Group Check` and `Changeset Overwrite Report` all concluded success; the dev's `check-changeset-presence` reading (10 source files of 3 released packages, 3 changesets) matches the file list.
- **`Clause-②: yes`** in the claim and the PR body matches the diff: the widening is real (two exports) and it is the reason for `minor`.
- **Bodies, in user terms, no over-claim.** data-objectstack: names both exports, the 422 headline-versus-issues split, the example line `• fields.amount.type — Required`, the fallback to `message`, the "keep newlines" rendering note, and "Additive: nothing existing changed" (true for this package). plugin-designer: says what the author saw (the headline) and sees now (one line per issue naming the field and the fix), and "Every other failure still shows its own message" is what the reader does. app-shell: "What they show is unchanged" is true (same grammar through the same reader); it does not mention the internal module's dropped exports and need not, since none was published.
- **Changeset claim re-read** (the gate's PR comment, exits 0): three pending bodies name files this PR touches. Read against the diff: `6519` is a scope note about which card owned `MetadataFieldsPage.tsx` in flight, not a claim this diff can falsify; `6681`'s statement that `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` statically imports `SuggestedBindingsPanel` stands (this diff touches only its `formatMetadataError` import lines); `8568`'s statement that the data-objectstack README's operator tables follow the implementation stands (this diff adds a section elsewhere). None went false. The dev report does not mention the re-read; non-blocking, noted.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **`open_questions`**: none declared; none found.
- **Pins (`MetadataFieldsPage.refusalIssues-11302.test.tsx`) — specific enough to fail on the old behaviour.** Real page, real `FieldDesigner`, real `DrawerForm` (name typed, submit pressed), real `MetadataClient` over a fetch double that runs the installed spec's `ObjectSchema` and answers the dispatcher envelope (`error.details.issues`); only `ObjectGrid` is the designer suite's mock, for the `grid-add-btn` affordance, and the grid is not on the save path. Each refusal case asserts `toBe(refusal.issues.map(formatMetadataIssue).join('\n'))` AND `not.toBe(refusal.message)`: on the old code the banner equals `refusal.message` exactly, so both fail. Prescription text is asserted by regex (`lowercase snake_case`, `Rename the key`). The multi-line pin asserts two `\n`-separated lines, `tagName` `PRE` and `className` containing `whitespace-pre-wrap`, so it says how the list renders. Controls: `good_name` passes the same gate (the PUT carries `['name','good_name']`, no banner), and a 503 without issues shows its own message. The instrument pins today's spec readings, including `constructor` as a field-less issue at `fields`, matching triage's upstream note (objectstack#20997); when that lands only the instrument line moves. The dev's committed-state ablation (anchor x2, 4 red, instrument and both controls green) is consistent with these assertions; it is the dev's measurement, not re-run here.
- **README (`packages/data-objectstack/README.md`, "Showing a Refused Metadata Save") — accurate to the code.** `client.save('object', 'account', {...})` matches `save(type, name, item, options?)`; the headline-versus-issues description matches `parseError`, which puts `details.issues` / `error.issues` / top-level `issues` on `err.issues`; the two example lines match the instrument's reading of `Bad Name` (`invalid_key` then `invalid_format` at the same path); the fallback and `whitespace-pre-line` note match the reader; `formatMetadataIssue` is described as the single-issue grammar for a `failed[]` lister, which is what app-shell does. `README Export Check` and `Doc Snippet Type Check` concluded success. AGENTS.md #2 also names `content/docs/guide/*.md`: `metadata-diagnostics.md`'s "Client SDK" and "Resource edit banners" sections cover the `_diagnostics` envelope, not a save refusal, so no guide statement went false; a pointer there would be optional, not owed. Accepted.
- **Out-of-scope finding (class a): `ResourceEditPage` shows `[object Object]` on the dispatcher face — fileable as its own card, not blocking here.** Mechanism confirmed at the head: the `INVALID_METADATA` branch reads `err?.body?.issues ?? []`, and on the dispatcher envelope the issues sit under `body.error.details.issues`, so `mapped` is empty; the fallback `String(err?.body?.error ?? err?.message ?? '')` stringifies the object `error` to `[object Object]`; the `failed spec validation:` regex does not match, so one root issue carrying that text is set, and the Save title `engine.validation.serverRefused` ("The server refused this draft — fix {issue} before saving.") interpolates the empty path. The producer is named in-repo by `parseError`'s own comment (the HTTP dispatcher sends `error` as an object with `details.issues`), and the dev measured the wrong result on the real `MetadataResourceEditPage` from the `serverRefusalGate` harness with a REST-shape control. Named site, named producer, measured wrong result: class (a). Not this card's defect (the fields page never reads `body`), and converging it would widen the file surface. Dedupe words: `ResourceEditPage object Object 422` · `dispatcher details.issues ResourceEditPage` · `metadata-admin refused save banner`.
- **Acceptance note: `PackagesPage` builds its own publish-drafts failure — stays an acceptance note.** Confirmed at the head: `publishDrafts` throws `engine.packages.detail.publishDraftsRolledBack` with `cause` built from the causal item's `type/name: error`, and `publishDraftsPartial` with counts; the causal item's `issues` are not read and `formatPublishFailures` is not imported there (its consumers are `StudioDesignSurface` and `AiChatPage`). It formats no issues, so it is not a second formatter; it is outside the file surface; and the on-screen result was not measured, so it does not yet meet the filing gate's "measured wrong result". Fileable once measured; candidate dedupe words then: `PackagesPage publishDrafts issues dropped` · `publish-drafts rolled back cause without issues` · `PackagesPage formatPublishFailures`.
